Answer: D
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with a significant shift of the trachea and mediastinum to the right (the unaffected side). This contralateral deviation indicates a space-occupying lesion, such as a massive pleural effusion, pushing structures away, whereas atelectasis or pneumonia with volume loss would pull the trachea toward the affected side.
